response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_rental_duration, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(replacement_cost, 0)) AS avg_rate_to_cost_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_rental_duration, avg_rate_to_cost_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, avg_rental_duration, avg_rate_to_cost_ratio, 0 AS sort_order FROM per_rating UNION ALL SELECT 'ALL RATINGS', AVG(avg_rental_duration), AVG(avg_rate_to_cost_ratio), 1 FROM per_rating) AS results ORDER BY sort_order, rating;
